connect.title: Join a table
connect.keyPlaceholder: the key your keeper minted for you
connect.name: Display name (optional)

session.empty: The chronicle is empty. Say something to begin.
session.inputPlaceholder: Speak, act, or type a command…
session.hiddenVar: Not exposed to players yet (Keeper view) — `.var expose <prefix>` puts it on the party panel.

studio.emptyHint: Create a card to start forging: typed variables, worldbook lore, and hooks.

save.copied: Copied to the clipboard (no save dialog here).

vars.hint: Typed module variables become validated engine trackers — kind, bounds, and visibility are enforced on write. Keeper-only variables never reach players and are excluded from SillyTavern exports.

wb.noEntries: No lore yet. Entries trigger on keywords, conditions, and ST-style timers.
wb.pickEntry: Pick an entry on the left, or add one.
wb.title: Title

hooks.hint: Sandboxed room hooks (QuickJS server-side). Events: turn_start, reply_ready, dice_rolled, variables_changed. Effects: inject, narrate, rewriteReply, emitUI, log, setvar/getvar.

err.idInvalid: Id must be 1-64 chars of a-z, 0-9, _ (spaces/hyphens become _).
err.optionsRequired: Enum needs at least one option.
err.defaultInvalid: Default does not fit the kind/options.
err.entryEmpty: Entry has neither title nor content.

split.emptyHint: Open any SillyTavern card (JSON or PNG). It splits into a character half any player may import, and the world machinery only the Keeper brings in.
split.counts: {{hooks}} hook script(s) · {{vars}} variable declaration(s) · {{ejs}} EJS block(s)
split.characterHint: EJS stripped, variable declarations removed, hooks detached — safe for any player to self-import. Edit freely; exports use these fields.
split.worldHint: What only the Keeper's world import carries in. Promote the MVU tree to typed variables below, then export the whole module as a pack source.
split.loreKept: {{n}} plain lore entries stay with the character half.
split.noHooks: No hook scripts on this card.
split.ejsHint: Executable template spans were stripped from the character half. They stay live in the original card, which the pack carries verbatim for the Keeper's world import.
split.exposeHint: Bare MVU leaves reach no player panel until the Keeper exposes them. These lines go into the pack notes:

promote.hint: Each InitVar leaf becomes a typed variable draft — confirm or edit every row. Rows left unchecked stay in the MVU tree untouched.
promote.truncated: Leaf cap reached (200) — the rest stay in the MVU tree.

note.listKept: list value — stays in the MVU tree
note.containerKept: nested value — stays in the MVU tree
note.nullKept: null value — stays in the MVU tree

ai.desktopOnly: AI drafting and the credential store need the desktop app.
ai.keyPlaceholder: pasted once, stored in the OS credential store
ai.keyHint: The key is written to the OS credential store (Keychain / Credential Manager / Secret Service) and never echoed back or saved in plain text. Requests are sent from the native side.
ai.engineRepoHint: Path to a loreweaver checkout — enables the `python -m app` pack builder when no loreweaver-server binary is on PATH.
ai.needsSetup: Configure a provider, model and API key first.
ai.worldPlaceholder: A drowned CoC harbor town where suspicion rises turn by turn; hidden ritual stage; the keeper tracks who has seen the fog…
ai.characterPlaceholder: A weary lighthouse keeper who speaks in short sentences and knows more than she says…
ai.rejected: The draft failed deterministic validation after {{n}} attempt(s). Nothing was saved.
ai.summary: {{vars}} typed variable(s) · {{lore}} worldbook entrie(s) · {{hooks}} hook script(s)

pack.dropHint: Drop SillyTavern cards, lorebooks or assets here — or add them one by one. Classification and splitting are deterministic; you confirm every step.
pack.kindLocked: Carries hooks / variable declarations / EJS — the engine requires kind: world.
pack.extractSkill: Also extract hooks into a skills/ directory (removed from the card copy so they don't install twice)
pack.pngHooksStay: PNG card: hooks stay inside the card and install with the Keeper's world import.
pack.reviewHint: Detected kinds are structural, not guesses: a card carrying hooks / [InitVar] / EJS is locked to kind: world (the engine enforces the same at build and install).
pack.noWorldCards: No world cards in this pack — nothing to promote.
pack.aiDraftHint: Drafts id, bilingual name/description and install notes from the detected contents. The card kind always comes from detection, never from the model.
pack.metadataClean: ✓ manifest fields pass the engine's author-side checks
pack.overwriteConfirm: {{dir}} already exists (from an earlier run). Overwrite it?
pack.buildTitle: 2 · Build with the engine (the single source of truth)
pack.noEngine: No engine CLI found — install loreweaver-server on PATH, or set the engine checkout in AI & engine settings. You can also run the command below yourself.
pack.installAfter: Install into the local server right after a successful build
pack.desktopOnly: Writing the source tree and running the engine need the desktop app.

err.packIdInvalid: Pack id must be a lowercase slug ([a-z0-9-], max 64).
err.packNameRequired: The pack needs a name (en or zh).
err.packDescriptionRequired: The pack needs a description (en or zh).
err.packLicenseRequired: License is required (SPDX id or short name).
err.packAuthorsRequired: At least one author is required.
err.packCardKindMismatch: {{file}} carries world machinery — it must be kind: world.
err.packSkillSlugInvalid: Skill slug "{{file}}" must be a lowercase slug.
err.packRulepackIdInvalid: Rulepack id "{{file}}" must be a lowercase slug.
